name: Globus Medical
outlook:
What Globus Medical says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueThe Company is updating its guidance for full-year 2026 revenue to $3.09 billion from the previous range of $3.18 billion to $3.22 billion, representing 5.1% revenue growth as compared to fiscal 2025.
  • Full year 2026: non-GAAP earnings per shareThe Company reaffirms its full-year fiscal 2026 non-GAAP fully diluted EPS guidance to be in the range of $4.95 to $5.05, representing 24.4% to 26.9% growth over fiscal 2025 non-GAAP fully diluted EPS.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
